project_name: KOLO App BLOC B1 — Onboarding, Paywall, Guided Tour & Profile

language_rules.i18n: Zero hardcoded strings. Requires i18n support for FR, EN, IT, DE with FR as default.

typography.font_family: SF Pro Display, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

type_scale.tiny_label: text-[11px] leading-[14px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#9CA3AF]

radius_tokens.r_full: 9999px (rounded-full for pill buttons, chips, and bottom nav)

OnboardingProgressBar.description: Progress indicator at top of each onboarding screen (Étape X sur 7).
OnboardingProgressBar.visuals: Horizontal track with soft rounded edges, filled with gradient/solid #EC8690. Text displays 'Étape X sur 7' in 13px bold dark grey.

PostalCodeChip.description: Chip representing validated postal codes with associated city name in onboarding zone step.
PostalCodeChip.visuals: White pill card with 1px border #EC8690, soft drop shadow, displaying postal code and resolved city name (e.g. '13008 · Marseille 8ᵉ'). Includes a pink delete icon.

PlanCard.description: Card for subscription plan selection (Découverte free vs Pro €24.99/month).
PlanCard.visuals: Pro card is visually featured with 24px rounded corners, solid #EC8690 background or heavy pink border, crown icon, €24.99/mois badge, feature checklist, and primary 'Commencer avec Pro' pill button. Découverte is presented cleanly with option to continue for free.

PillButton.description: Universal primary action button throughout BLOC B1.
PillButton.visuals: Fully pill-shaped (rounded-full), filled #EC8690 background, white bold text, elevated soft pink glow shadow (`--b1-shadow-cta`), interactive press state scaling to 0.97.

BottomTabPill.description: Floating pill bottom navigation bar with pink border and 4 distinct tab icons.
BottomTabPill.visuals: Floating pill container (`rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-[#EC8690] p-1.5 shadow-[0_12px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]`). Active tab receives a filled pink pill background (`bg-[#EC8690] text-white rounded-full px-4 py-2`). Inactive tabs display subtle pink/grey outline icons.

GuideTooltip.description: Guided tour floating step tooltips (6-step onboarding overlay).
GuideTooltip.visuals: White rounded card with pink accent border, step counter ('1/6'), title, body explanation, 'Suivant' pill button, dark backdrop overlay, pointing arrow to target UI element. Step 1 features an animated swipe hand icon.

ProfileMenuItem.description: Row item in Profile screen menu matching mockup m1.
ProfileMenuItem.visuals: White row card or flat list item with left pink circular icon container (`w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-[#FDF2F4] text-[#EC8690] flex items-center justify-center`), medium text title, right chevron icon (`lucide-react ChevronRight`).

InfoProCompletenessBar.description: Completeness progress card for user profile.
InfoProCompletenessBar.visuals: Soft pink container with percentage indicator and action prompt to complete agent information.

onboarding_7_screens: Screen 1 (Identity): First name + Last name inputs, keyboard auto-focus, 'Continuer' button enabled when both valid.
Screen 2 (Status): Tap cards choice ('Agent immobilier' vs 'Directeur d'agence'), single selection card with pink border highlight on active.
Screen 3 (Zones): Numeric keyboard input for 1-2 postal codes. Displays resolved city name underneath each code (e.g. '13008 · Marseille 8ᵉ').
Screen 4 (Spinner): Smooth animated scanning/processing state checking coverage.
Screen 5 (Zone Result): Displays result screen — either covered ('Continuer') or not covered ('Modifier ma zone').

Screen 6 (Paywall Plan): Apple IAP compliant paywall showcasing 'Pro €24.99/mois' card with primary CTA 'Commencer avec Pro'. 'Continuer en Découverte' text link for free plan. Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and Restore Purchases links required at bottom.
Screen 7 (Ready): Final confirmation screen 'Vous êtes prêt' with CTA 'Voir mes opportunités'.
guided_tour_6_bubbles: Bubble 1: Welcome & Swipe gestures intro with looping swipe hand animation overlaying Opportunity card.
Bubble 2: Property detail highlights (DPE, Superficie, Price/m²).
Bubble 3: Estimation tool shortcut on bottom nav.
Bubble 5: KOLO AI Assistant chatbot introduction.
Bubble 6: Profile & Settings access from top right header avatar.
profile_screen: Top Header: Avatar icon + Performance chart icon in top right.
Active Plan Card: Big filled pink card ('Votre plan actuel Pro' with crown icon).

Menu List: Information personnelle, Informations professionnelles, Zones de prospection, Plan et mode de paiement, Revoir le tour guidé, Contacter le support KOLO, Supprimer mon compte (in-app deletion required by Apple).
Logout: 'Se déconnecter' text button at bottom in pink accent color.
apple_iap_compliance: No external payment links anywhere on Paywall or App.
No agency pricing or enterprise references outside standard IAP tiers.
Must include 'Restore Purchases' (Raurer les achats) button on Screen 6.
Must include visible links to Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
Must include functional in-app account deletion ('Supprimer mon compte') in Profile menu.

motion_specs.screen_transition: Onboarding step-to-step slide transition with 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
motion_specs.button_tap: Scale down to 0.97 on press state with spring physics (stiffness 400, damping 25).
motion_specs.tour_bubble_entry: Fade in + scale from 0.92 to 1.0 with subtle spring entrance (300ms).
motion_specs.swipe_hand_loop: Continuous subtle side-to-side drag animation keyframes for tour bubble 1 swipe indicator.

iconography_rules.library: lucide-react for all general UI icons.

custom_svg_nav_icons.opportunites: Swipe hand icon with directional movement arrows.
custom_svg_nav_icons.estimation: Calculator icon with embedded dollar/euro symbol.
custom_svg_nav_icons.rapport: Document page icon with a centered download arrow.
custom_svg_nav_icons.assistant: Cute small robot head icon matching mockup m2 mascot.

instructions_to_main_agent: Wrap BLOC B1 components in the `.b1-root` top-level CSS class to scope styles safely without leaking to app-v2 or marketing.
Strictly adhere to the formal French 'Vouvoiement' ('vous') for all text across all 7 onboarding screens, paywall, tour, and profile.
Implement zero hardcoded text strings by connecting all copy to the i18n translation engine (supporting FR, EN, IT, DE with FR default).

Ensure Apple IAP compliance: absolute prohibition of external payment URLs/links, mandatory 'Restauration des achats' button, TOS & Privacy links on Screen 6, and functional in-app account deletion under Profile menu.
Maintain exact layout and structure from the reference mockups, enhancing depth with soft ambient shadows (`--b1-shadow-card`), active pressed scale transitions, and rounded 24px corners.
Render the floating bottom navigation bar as a pill container with pink border and 4 tabs (Opportunités, Estimation, Rapport, Assistant). Active tab must display as a filled pink pill background.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all buttons, inputs, tabs, cards, and interactive elements across all screens for automated E2E testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid="onboarding-next-btn").
Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled inputs.
Use specific property transitions instead of transition: all.
Avoid using emoji characters as icons — use lucide-react or custom SVG vectors.
Ensure high contrast ratio and accessibility standards for text over pink/lavender backgrounds.
